description_en: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserBillType operation to query the billing method for a user
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnUserBillType查询用户的计费类型
name: DescribeDcdnUserBillType

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

结束时间需大于起始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间。
格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

BillTypeDataItem.description_en: The list of billing data for the user

BillType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

hour_flow: pay-by-hourly-traffic.

day_bandwidth: pay-by-daily-bandwidth.

month_95: pay-by-monthly-95th-percentile-bandwidth.

month_avg_day_bandwidth: pay-by-monthly-average-of-daily-peak-bandwidth.

month_4th_day_bandwidth: pay-by-monthly-4th-peak-bandwidth.

month_avg_day_95: pay-by-monthly-average-of-daily-95th-percentile-bandwidth.

month_95_night_half: pay-by-monthly-95th-percentile-bandwidth-with-50%-off-for-night-usage.

hour_vas: pay-by-hourly-value-added-service.

quic_hour_count: pay-by-hourly-QUIC-requests.

hour_count: pay-by-hourly-requests.

rtlog_count_day: pay-by-daily-real-time-logs
BillType.description_zh:
计费模式。取值：

hour_flow：小时流量。
day_bandwidth：日带宽。
month_95：月95。
month_avg_day_bandwidth：月均日峰值。
month_4th_day_bandwidth：月第四日峰值。
month_avg_day_95：月均日95。
month_95_night_half：夜间半价95。
hour_vas：小时增值服务。
quic_hour_count：小时QUIC请求数。
hour_count：小时请求次数。
rtlog_count_day：实时日志

Dimension.description_en:
The dimension. Valid values:

flow: bandwidth.

vas: value-added service, such as HTTPS and dynamic requests.

websocket: WebSocket.

quic: QUIC requests.

rtlog2sls: real-time log delivery to Simple Log Service (SLS)
Dimension.description_zh:
维度。取值：

flow：流量带宽。
vas：增值服务（HTTPS、动态请求）。
websocket：网络套接字。
quic：QUIC请求数。
rtlog2sls：实时日志推送SLS

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the billing method

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the billing method
